questions.question: Please supply an archival shelfmark or edition page for “Whenever I am infuriated…” in the letter to Sidney Herbert dated 19 August 1857. The source gives the date and addressee but no precise locator; both are retained in Russian and English. Membership in 1858 has been verified against the RSS itself at https://rss.org.uk/news-publication/news-publications/2020/general-news/nightingale-2020-the-bicentenary-our-first-female/ and is not an open question.
